body:
@WinKawaks Lottie doesn't support fitXY. You can manually set scaleX and scaleY on the view or parent view manually if you need this behavior.
Lottie only supports centerInside and centerCrop because they don't distort the original aspect ratio.

issue.title: Lottie animation not centered on Samsung S20

repository.name: cordova-plugin-lottie-splashscreen
repository.description: 🐣 🎬 📱 Apache Cordova plugin to show Lottie animations as the splash screen with Airbnb's Lottie wrapper

issue.body:
# Bug report

## What steps will reproduce the problem?

Using the Ionic project with the [Lottie SplashScreen](https://ionicframework.com/docs/native/lottie-splash-screen), build the application for Android and run it on two different mobile devices.

## Expected output

The lottie animation to be visualized centered into the screen, like in the following image (taken from a Huawei P30 Pro):

![huawei p30 pro](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25931536/116897897-12e2d880-ac36-11eb-955a-af96fe6d4aec.JPEG)

## What do you see instead?

The lottie animation is displayed on the bottom of the screen.

![samsung s20](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25931536/116897927-19715000-ac36-11eb-9147-0f38bd5b4ff8.jpeg)
